title: Lost & Found

[[File:Chest.png|thumb|Lost & Found]] '''Lost & Found''' is a storage for items and coins found in [[Jerry]] on the [[Private Island]]. However, sometimes when a Server Restarts (example), if you lost an item you might not be able to retrieve it. Do not rely on this. == Usage == Lost & Found storage serves as a storage for items and coins that couldn't be directly refunded to the player. It can be opened at any time by clicking the slot below deliveries. Known ways items or coins may end up there include: * [[Bazaar]] buy/sell order claim * [[Auction House]] * Leaving the lobby before the item bought from [[Dark Auction]] is claimed == Description == ''"Apparently you lost some''
